protocol.scene_selection: All six pre-existing timed-arrival scenes; no performance filtering
protocol.candidates: Per model and correct-history speed: exact saved CEM plan and previously validated speed-aware constant control

modes.free: Native H3 autoregression, no future observations
modes.current: At each call replace only current latent by true encoding; preceding two remain this arm's autoregressive outputs; replacement is not stored
modes.past: At each call replace preceding two latents by true encodings; current remains this arm's autoregressive output
modes.full: Each call receives the three real consecutive frames ending before the predicted transition

protocol.action_alignment: Window t:t+3 uses actions leaving those three frames; raw future commands clipped then normalized
protocol.interpretation: Full refresh compares free multistep prediction with one-step prediction on true trajectories. It removes predicted-input errors and supplies fresh dynamical evidence simultaneously. Partial mixed latent histories are privileged sensitivity diagnostics, not valid inference tracks or an additive causal decomposition.
protocol.history_check: Training-free red-agent pixel localization with known renderer; least-squares speed estimate from each of the two action blocks. No hidden speed or state used by estimator. This proves information availability for this Speed panel, not native encoder sufficiency or other tasks.
protocol.metrics: Within-checkpoint squared latent error per depth, refresh/free error ratio, pairwise terminal cost preference, no-contact subgroup. No between-model raw latent comparisons.
protocol.statistics: Aggregate both candidates and all speeds within scene; equal scenes; paired scene bootstrap 10000 draws seed20260930. Report each candidate type separately too.
protocol.limitations: Only six Speed scenes and two existing checkpoints. Refresh knows future observations and cannot be deployed during open-loop planning. Model capacity and longer trained history need training controls to identify causally.
